facts.fact: The Ministry of Housing and Lands says the whole land transaction process has been computerized in an integrated LAVIMS system, with the Cadastre Unit fully operational since April 2012.

LAVIMS links a digital cadastral database, a valuation of all residential and commercial sites and a parcel-based deeds registration system, and the Cadastre Unit links registered deeds to digital cadastre parcels.

systems.platform: digital cadastral database, valuation, deeds registration
